List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

Reduction in Holidays
*241. SHRI  LALITBHAI  MEHTA:
SHRIMATI  SAVITA  SHARDA:
Will the Minister of PERSONNEL,
PUBLIC GRIEVANCES AND
PENSIONS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of days a year, the
Government of India employees work
considering holidays of Saturdays,
Sundays, Gazetted Holidays, Restricted
Holidays and various types of leave availed
by them;
(b) whether Government have
examined the possibility of reducing the
Gazetted Holidays by permitting
employees of respective religious faiths a
holiday on that particular day and avoid
closing of Government offices;
(c) whether Government have also
examined the possibility of restoring a six
day week to increase the number of
working days; and
(d) whether Government propose to
conduct any study on  the effects of
observance of so many holidays on
developmental works and routine
administration of Government of India?
Establishment of a Fluoride
Mitigation Centre in Gujarat
*242.DR. A.K. PATEL:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
of Gujarat has submitted a proposal to the
Ministry of Rural Development for
establishing a Fluoride Mitigation Centre;
(b) if so, whether any decision has been
taken thereon; and
(c) if not, by when the decision is likely
to be taken?
Utilisation of funds under the Indira
Awas Yojana
*243. SHRI  VIJAY J.  DARDA:
 SHRIMATI  N. P.  DURGA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the States/
UTs are not sending their monthly progress
reports on the implementation of Indira
Awas Yojana;

72
(b) if so, in what manner Government
would propose to ensure that the funds
allotted to the States under this category
are being utilised and are not being
reappropriated for other purposes; and
(c) the quantum of funds allotted
State/UT-wise and the extent to which
the same have been utilised?
PMGSY in Arunachal Pradesh
*244. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of targets fixed for the
construction of roads during the Tenth Plan
under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak
Yojana in the State of Arunachal Pradesh;
and
(b) the details of roads constructed
under the scheme so far in the State?
Performance of private power
companies in Delhi
*245. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
private companies to whom distribution
of power in Delhi had been assigned with
effect from 1st July, 2002 have ushered in
a state of indecision in regard to granting
new connections, taking decision on
aspects relating to granting connections to
co-operative societies, tariff sharing
between consumer and these companies
etc.;
(b) whether Government have made
any assessment of the performance of these
companies in Delhi vis-a-vis the
difficulties faced by consumers; and
(c) if so, what assistance has been given
to State Government of Delhi before this
experiment is tried elsewhere?
MoU signed between PGCI and State
Grid Corporation of China
*246. DR. T. SUBBARAMI  REDDY:
SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Power Grid
Corporation of India Limited has signed a
Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)
with State Grid Corporation of China on
9th July, 2003;
(b) if so, to what extent this will help
in developing the power generation and
power distribution in India; and
(c) by when the work on this MoU is
likely to be started?
Funds for poverty alleviation in KBK
districts of Orissa
*247. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what is the amount given to the
eight KBK districts in Orissa for poverty
alleviation programmes from 1995 to
2003, year-wise and district-wise;
(b) whether Government have
approved any agency other than State
Government to review this poverty
alleviation programme in all KBK
districts;
(c) whether it is a fact that the funds
which were given for poverty alleviation
programme could not be fully utilised; and
(d) if so, the details of funds utilised
from 1995 to 2002?

73
Tipaimukh Dam Project
*248. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Electricity
Authority has accorded techno-economic
clearance to the 1500 MW (6 x 250 MW)
Tipaimukh Dam Project on the river Barak
in Manipur/Mizoram;
(b) if so, whether this project is likely
to provide impetus to the economic and
developmental activities in the North
Eastern Region;
(c) whether during the last 12 months
the CEA has cleared projects which will
help generate upto 11,500 MW of power;
(d) if so, the details of these projects;
and
(e) by when they are likely to be
completed?
Losses suffered by NDMC
*249. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether NDMC suffers staggering
loss of Rs. 3.84 crore annually;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether abnormal delay in revision
of licence fee, improper maintenance of
records and vital information has become
the practice there;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the steps taken to remedy the
situation?
Revival of NTC Mills
*250. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) the latest position of the revival of
NTC Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala
and Madras (APKK & M) Mills;
(b) the date on which the revival period
expires as per the BIFR order;
(c) whether Government  propose to
fulfil its commitment in the BIFR revival
package order within the stipulated revival
period; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
action taken for the payment under VRS
to surplus workers in the reviving mills?
Royalty given to States
*251. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of COAL be
pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of royalty given to the
States for mining of coal and lignite
separately;
(b) the balance of royalty due to be paid
to Tamil Nadu for mining lignite at
Neyveli; and
(c) when the royalty for lignite was last
revised?
Clearance for SGPC members/
employees for trips abroad
*252. SARDAR GURCHARAN
SINGH TOHRA:
SHRI SUKHDEV SINGH
LIBRA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any order in force

74
that requires members and employees of
Shiromani Gurdwara Prabhandhak
Committee (SGPC) to get clearance from
Home Ministry before they are allowed to
go on a trip abroad;
(b) whether Government are actively
considering to review and repeal of such
order; and
(c) if so, by when a final decision is
likely to be taken in this regard?
Power projects in private sector
†*253. SHRIMATI KUM KUM
RAI:Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of projects for power
generation being operated in the private
sector and whether performance of these
projects is not as per Government's
expectations;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Cases registered by Anti-Corruption
Branch of Delhi Police
*254. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases registered by
the Anti-Corruption Branch in the Delhi
Police against the officials working in
Government/Civic bodies offices during
the current year;
(b) the number of cases registered
during the last year and decided by the
court; and
(c) the steps which have been taken by
Government for expeditious disposal of
such cases?
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
in Jharkhand
*255. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the scheme
for road connectivity between the rural
areas and the highways under the Pradhan
Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana is being
implemented in the State of Jharkhand;
(b) if so, the details of implementation
of the scheme so far and targets fixed for
the Tenth Five Year Plan period;
(c) the details of the major bottlenecks
identified; and
(d) the steps contemplated to overcome
the same?
Power projects under APDRP in
Andhra Pradesh
*256. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
sanctioned some projects to the State of
Andhra Pradesh under Accelerated Power
Development and Reforms Programme;
(b) if so, the number of projects
sanctioned for Tirupati circle; and
(c) the details of mandals included in
Tirupati circle?
Budgetary support to Indian Cotton
Mills Federation
†*257. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian Cotton Mills
Federation (ICMF) had demanded Rs. 400
crore annually as budgetary support from
the Centre in order to improve the poor
financial condition of the Indian Cotton
Mills;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

75
(b) if so, the provision for  the purpose
made in the financial year 2003-2004 and
the funds sanctioned to improve the
condition of cotton Mills and to make
textile industry competitive;
(c) whether any Technology
Upgradation Fund (T.U.F.) has been
formed for textile sector; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Clearance of power projects by CEA
*258. SHRI  PARMESHWAR
KUMAR  AGARWALLA:  Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Electricity Authority has given clearance
to several projects recently;
(b) if so, the details of the projects,
cleared during the last one year;
(c) the capacity of the projects and total
investment involved; and
(d) the present status of the projects?
System to forewarn people about
Cyclones
*259. MS.  PRAMILA  BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
in the last cyclone there was heavy loss of
life and property as the residents of the
coastal areas could not be forewarned well
before time;
(b) if so, whether Government have
now developed any system to forewarn the
people before such a natural calamity takes
on them; and
(c) if so, the success of such a
system and how far it has been used to
save the lives and property of coastal
people?
Memoranda on demands of Kashmiri
Pandits
*260. DR. AKHILESH DAS: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether during the visit of the VIPs
to the displaced Kashmiri Pandits' camp
in Jammu in June this year, any
memoranda on their demands was
presented for relief and rehabilitation;
(b) if so, the details of their demands;
and
(c) Government's response and reaction
thereto?

Production of 'A' grade coal
1797. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) the production of 'A' grade coal in
the country, State-wise, during last five
years;
(b) whether it is a fact that Public Sector
Coal Companies dispatch good quality coal
produced in Madhya Pradesh to other
States; and
(c) if so, the reasons for depriving
Madhya Pradesh the legitimate access to
their own natural resource?
Loss of coal in Jharia fires
1798. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
underground fires occur every year in the
town of Jharia in the State of Jharkhand;
(b) if so, whether Government have
chalked out any plan to prevent the
underground fires; and
(c) whether it is a fact that the loss of
coal due to underground fires is more than
37 million tons that costs the exchequer
more than Rs. 7000 crore?
Effects of Jharia fire on population
1799. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that nearly four
lakh inhabitants of Jharia in Jharkhand are
facing eviction due to underground fire;
(b) whether Government have
undertaken any action to rehabilitate them;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Private sector participation in coal
mining
1800. SHRI RAJU PARMAR: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
enact legislation to allow private sector
participation in coal mining; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard?

394
Development work undertaken by
WCL
1801. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Western Coalfields Ltd.
has undertaken any community
development and labour welfare work in
its coal producing areas;
(b) if so, the State-wise and district-
wise details of the areas where such work
have been undertaken;
(c) the name of development work
undertaken; and
(d) the amount spent on these
development works?
Coal mines and their production
†1802. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of mines in the country
and the location thereof;
(b) the total quantity of coal in tons
extracted in the country every day;
(c) the number of employees engaged
directly and indirectly in each mine, the
mine-wise details thereof; and
(d) whether Government are
contemplating to formulate any scheme for
the welfare of the employees engaged in
the mines?
Delegation of powers by C.I.L.
1803. SHRI C.P. THIRUNA-
VUKKARASU: Will the Minister of
COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Coal India Limited
proposes to delegate its powers to its
subsidiaries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what will be the role of C.I.L.
thereafter;
(d) whether the C.I.L. proposes to give
permission for sale of the mines to the
manufacturing sector;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Implementation of Jharkhand High
Court Directives
1804. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Hon'ble High Court,
Jharkhand vide its order dated 16th January,
2003 has issued certain directions to
CIL/CCL in I.A. No. 2020/2002 in
CWJC No. 2750 (97)-R;
(b) if so, whether the said directions
could not be implemented as yet;
(c) whether Government is maintaining
any mechanism to oversee the functioning
of the CIL and its subsidiaries; and
(d) if so, why the High Court directions
could not be implemented well in time?
Steps to boost FDI in coal and mining
sector
1805. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any strategy to boost the
Foreign Direct Investment in coal and
mining sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are considering
to set up a Regulatory Authority for the
country's coal sector;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

395
CIL agreement with ONGC for
commercial exploitation of CBM
1806. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Coal India Limited has
made any agreement with ONGC for
commercial exploitation of Coal Red
Methane in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any of the block from WCL
has been chosen for development of CBM
under this agreement;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Steps to tackle Pak-trained terrorists
1807. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that documents
seized from Pak-trained terrorists in J&K
showed that they are trained in creating
chemical weapons and using poisons for
mass destruction; and
(b) if so, the details of the discoveries
made and the action-plan of Government to
control this ill-conceived plan of Pakistan?
Defence agreements
1808. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the agreements signed
with various countries for the past two
years;
(b) how would the same enhance our
defence capabilities;
(c) the amount involved in these
agreements; and
(d) the steps taken by the Ministry to
monitor such agreements?
Golden Jubilee year of BEL
1809. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of employees
including officers working in Bharat
Electronics Limited, Bangalore;
(b) whether the above factory has
completed 50 years of its existence;
(c) the details of various programmes
being organised during the golden jubilee
year;
(d) whether the Management has taken
steps to honour those who are responsible
for its programme on the occasion of its
golden jubilee; and
(e) whether the Government has
conferred 'Navaratna' status on its golden
jubilee year?
Landmine casualties in Rajasthan
1810. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the landmines have claimed
113 victims in Sriganganagar district of
Rajasthan during the 15 months of the
military mobilisation since December, 2001;
(b) whether there were even agricultural
losses and villagers returning home were
not sure that their fields and grazing
pastures have been entirely demined; and
(c) if so, what steps are being taken by
Government to make demining a cent per
cent success?

396
MiG-23 accidents
1811. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is fact that MiG-23s have
higher accident rate than MiG-21s;
(b) if so, whether the accident rate of
MiG-23s per 10,000 hours of flying is the
highest in the IAF fleet;
(c) the reasons for not phasing out of
the ageing MiG-23s by Government; and
(d) whether Government have made any
investigation to find out why MiG-23s are
prone to accident?
Recommendation of Parliamentary
Standing Committee on Defence
1812. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Parliamentary Standing Committee on
Defence has recommended formulating a
pre-audited five years defence budget in
order to prevent delays in acquisition of
weapons; and
(b) if so, what action Government have
taken in this regard?
Launching of LCA
1813. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Prime
Minister has launched LCA in the first
week of May, 2003;
(b) whether the technology
demonstration of LCA has also been done;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the target set by the Ministry to
produce LCA on large scale in the next five
years;
(e) whether the Ministry is thinking of
exporting LCA to other countries of the
world; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
One-rank one-pension scheme
†1814. SHRI D.P. YADAV: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
implementing the 'one-rank one-pension'
scheme for the retired jawans/officers to
the army;
(b) if so, since when; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Upgradation of Bofors Gun
1815. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal for the upgradation of the Bofors
Gun; and
(b) if so, the details of the upgradation
and total amount earmarked therefor?
Acquisition of wheeled S.P. Gun
1816. SHRI SURESH KALMADI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the present status in respect of the
acquisition of wheeled S.P. Gun;
(b) whether it is a fact that the General
Service Qualification Requirement was
changed after the opening of tender; if so,
the reasons therefor; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

397
(c) whether Government propose to
invite fresh tenders for the same?
Help to 1971 war hero
1817. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
a 71-War Hero Col.(Retd.) Suresh Y. Rege,
who had received the Sena Medal for
gallantry in 1971 war, is yet to receive,
after 33 years, the promised four hectares
of unirrigated land and 300 sq. metres of
residential land, after infructuous
correspondence for the last 30 years with
officials of Maharashtra Government; and
(b) if so, will the Defence Ministry lend
its helping hand to get the matter sorted
out for this 70-year old war hero?
Establishment of Thermal Imager
Detector Unit in A.P.
1818. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any request from the
Government of Andhra Pradesh has been
received in the Ministry for establishing
Bharat Electronics Limited's Thermal
Imager Detector Unit at either
Machilipatnam or Hyderabad;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal
sent by the Government of Andhra Pradesh;
(c) when such request was received in
the Ministry;
(d) whether it is also a fact that the
Government of Andhra Pradesh agreed to
extend all support for the establishment of
the above Unit in Andhra Pradesh; and
(e) if so, what action the Ministry has
contemplated on the request of the State
Government of Andhra Pradesh?
Indo-Russian naval exercise
1819. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Navy carried out an operational exercise
with the Russian Navy in the Indian Ocean
for the first time;
(b) if so, whether the new thrust was
on Anti-Submarine Warfare and Air
Defence; and
(c) if so, the significance of this exercise
and the extent of cooperation between the
two Navies?
Funds for Ranikhet Cantonment
Board

the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:

(b) whether Government are aware of
the fact that due to the paucity of funds,
roads of the Board are not being maintained
and improved;
(c) if so, whether the Board have
demanded funds for this item; and
(d) if so, whether this amount would be

(a) whether Government propose to set
up a Naval Academy;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the location; and

(c) by when the project is likely to be
completed?
Welfare measures for Defence
Personnel
1822. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Army is contemplating
to set up Medical and Dental Colleges and
other professional institutes for Army
Personnel and their families;
(b) if so, the details of their locations;
and
(c) the other welfare measures taken for
Defence Personnel and their families?
Defence Planning Board
1823. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is planning to
set up Defence Planning Board;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what will be the main functions of
the Board and  by when it is likely to be set
up?
Outstanding bills against Andhra
Pradesh Government for use of
IAF aircraft
1824. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air
Headquarters had sent airlift bills to the
tune of Rs. 3 crores to the Government of
Andhra Pradesh for aircraft used during
floods in the State in August, 2000;
(b) if so, whether the Government of
Andhra Pradesh requested for waiver of
above bills in view of drought conditions
prevailing in the State; and
(c) if so, the details of the action by the
Ministry in this regard?
Illegal Bangladeshis in voters lists
1825. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that thousands of
illegal Bangladeshi migrants in Delhi are
figuring the voters lists;
(b) whether Government propose to
move the Election Commission to get their
names deleted; if so, when this exercise
would be over; and
(c) whether illegal migrants so detected
would be deported to their own country?
Involvement of policemen in bungling
of money recovered from robbers
1826. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a few police
officers of Anand Vihar Police Station,
Delhi have been suspended by the Delhi
Police Commissioner for allegedly
bungling  Rs. 1 crore recovered by them
from the robbers;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons for not awarding deterrent
punishment to those officials who pocketed
the entire loot instead of depositing that
amount with the Department?

399
'Hafta Wasooli' by Delhi Police
1827. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
